      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-

                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The pet owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where
                LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and
                NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation
                equal to one more than the number of owners at that time.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                The stable identifier shared by all owners of the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created
                with 'sharesHousehold' true and joins an existing household; the
                joining owner and the existing household members all carry the
                same value. Absent for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived key used for duplicate detection, formed as the
                normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or empty when
                absent) and the household id (or empty when absent) joined with
                '|'. A new owner is rejected with 409 Conflict only when its
                whole identity key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared the same first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner
                was created. Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date's year
                (e.g. 'SMI-0007-M26'). Assigned once at creation and returned
                unchanged.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 3, derived at
                creation: it starts at 1, gains 1 when an email address is
                present, gains 1 when the namesake count is 0, and is capped at 3
                (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the pet owner's city using the
                fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the moment this owner was created.
                Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference

              type: string

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. It is then stored and returned in that E.164 form (e.g.
            '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678'). A value that cannot form
            valid E.164 is rejected with 400.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099 for cities in the
            Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD table); a city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. A malformed or
            out-of-range postcode is rejected with 400. It is stored and
            returned unchanged.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create the server sets it to its current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address (i.e. they share a household).
            Write-only; it is not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The pet owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where
                LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and
                NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation
                equal to one more than the number of owners at that time.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                The stable identifier shared by all owners of the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created
                with 'sharesHousehold' true and joins an existing household; the
                joining owner and the existing household members all carry the
                same value. Absent for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived key used for duplicate detection, formed as the
                normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or empty when
                absent) and the household id (or empty when absent) joined with
                '|'. A new owner is rejected with 409 Conflict only when its
                whole identity key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared the same first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner
                was created. Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date's year
                (e.g. 'SMI-0007-M26'). Assigned once at creation and returned
                unchanged.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 3, derived at
                creation: it starts at 1, gains 1 when an email address is
                present, gains 1 when the namesake count is 0, and is capped at 3
                (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the pet owner's city using the
                fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the moment this owner was created.
                Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The pet owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the
                stored contact details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
